coordinates: concept pixels, top-left origin; pixel (i, j) covers [i, i + 1) x [j, j + 1)

registration.model: donor_px = M (p - c) + t; p concept pixel index, c the target box centre, donor pixel index
registration.metric: normalized cross-correlation of high-passed luminance (concept sigma 6 px, donor sigma 6 px times the upscale) on a 3 px grid inside the target box inset 8 px: for the hag, inside her silhouette by at least registration_inset_px under the upscale's own mapping; for the plate donor, outside the exclusion distance from her silhouette
